title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
summary: Krebs on Security reports on the FBI investigation into a dark web service that allegedly sold personal data of 153+ million driver licenses. The breach raises significant concerns about identity theft risks and the security of government-issued identification databases.
problem_solved: This is a news report about a data breach, not a solution—reports on how threat actors exposed massive amounts of driver license data and the resulting federal investigation.
why_valuable: Highlights the scale of personal data exposure and underscores the critical importance of protecting government-issued ID databases from unauthorized access.
